_meta.countsAreApproximate: IA's availability API is inconsistent — it returned false 'none' for texas-tech, maealiuaki-smith and gray-heard-asi (all actually archived). Verify with the CDX API (web.archive.org/cdx), not availability. Of page 1: ~19 have real 200 captures; play-of-the-game and conservative-kstate have ONLY 301-redirect snapshots (no article content — treat as missing); jake-schultz, gavin-roberts, timeout-asu, wbb-cincinnati appear genuinely uncaptured. Get these via Timothy's own PDF saves.
_meta.hostCrawlNote: 2026-07-07: O'Colly runs on a small student-paper server. Burst archiving overloaded it and the Internet Archive paused crawling ocolly.com (error:host-crawling-paused). Finish the remaining 9 saves + page-2 discovery SLOWLY — one request every several minutes, after a cooldown. Never burst-request this host.
_meta.note: Source of truth for the portfolio's Work grid AND the archive manifest. status: indexed = known from search, no snapshot yet; wayback = permanent Wayback snapshot exists (no local full-text copy yet); archived = wayback snapshot + local copy both saved.
_meta.citationFormat: "{headline}." By Timothy Christensen. The O'Colly, {date}. Original: {url}. Archived: {waybackUrl}.
_meta.photoFields: Per-clip image fields to capture: imageUrl (feature/lead photo — local or archived copy), imageCredit (the staff photographer, usually NOT Timothy), imageCaption (original caption text).
_meta.rightsNote: Feature photos are shot by O'Colly staff photographers, not Timothy, and are copyright the photographer / O'Colly. On the live site, only display a feature photo WITH a visible credit line, and prefer small thumbnails that link to the original over large reproductions. Full-res photos stay in the private local archive only.
_meta.source: Rebuilt from O'Colly RSS feed (archive/ocolly-feed.rss) — f=rss on the search URL. Feed gives title, link, date, byline, summary, and feature-image URL for every clip, with no 429 (RSS is not behind the bot-block that walls off article pages). This is now the authoritative catalog.
_meta.remaining: Full article BODY text and specific photographer credit are NOT in RSS — get those from the ~20 Wayback snapshots (readable via curl) and/or an ArchiveWeb.page capture. Feature images downloadable from the townnews CDN (see localImage once fetched).
